name: Baked Tofu Fajita Tray
ingredients: 250 g extra-firm tofu, cut in strips
1 tsp each cumin, smoked paprika and garlic powder
½ tsp chilli powder and juice of 1 lime
¼ avocado and coriander, to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the tofu, peppers and onion with the oil, spices, lime juice and salt on a large tray.
Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once, until the tofu is golden and the vegetables charred.
Fill the tortillas with the tofu mixture and beans.
Top with avocado, coriander and salsa.
note: A one-tray dinner with about 26 g protein per serving.
